"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew Kamphey做了个Google Sheets教程站，Better Sheets。月入5000美元（约3.6万人民币）。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "Andrew以前是干什么的？"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "用Google Apps Script自动化自己的工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用了5年，他没意识到这就是在学编程。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那时候他在一家娱乐创业公司，同事们叫他"那个Google Sheets家伙"。办公室角落里的表格巫师。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他爱帮别人解决问题，但也梦想着独立开发。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2018年，他辞职了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一次创业卖了个网站和通讯，3.7万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当时年收入才1.2万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后他迷上了SaaS。花了两年时间做了个叫Hypeletter的产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最后怎样？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月收200美元，卡住了，死了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "正是这次失败，让他真正的价值被看见。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "合伙人在找域名时，他做了个评分表，自动计算每个域名的分数——长度、com域名可用性、含义等等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对Andrew来说，这只是个简单表格。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对合伙人来说，"这太牛逼了。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年，SaaS失败，疫情封锁。他终于开始了真正的独立开发。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Better Sheets怎么开始的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "24小时内，他用Loom录了8个视频。无剪辑，直接上。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "4个免费，4个付费，放在Gumroad landing page上。Gumroad免费直到你赚到钱， perfect for testing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个月收入390美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后AppSumo找上门，起飞了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew的收入来源很分散："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Gumroad模板工具：12%", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stripe订阅咨询：22%", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AppSumo终身授权：50%", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AppSumo Marketplace：4%", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Udemy课程：10%", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "YouTube广告：2%", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Google Sheets插件：0%（免费）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最大的突破是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lifetime Deal（终身授权）。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "受MakerPad启发，他从一开始就做终身授权。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当时觉得这是劣势——没有循环收入。结果成了最大的优势。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AppSumo看中了这个模式，还选他做"Sumo-ling Spotlight"（现在叫AppSumo Marketplace）的首期产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从几十个客户，几个月内涨到1000+。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AppSumo用户正好是他的目标受众——用Google Sheets做业务的人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew说，他做这个生意不是为了赚钱。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是为了掌控和独立。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""只要能维持生活方式，其他的都是锦上添花。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他最近意识到，需要为儿子的教育存钱了。所以开始重视咨询业务。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "以前他把精力放在YouTube和Udemy上。这些是好收入来源，但咨询能 overshadow 它们。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO他也做了，但反馈太慢。做了改动，要3-6个月才看到结果。这让他很焦虑，总觉得自己落下了什么。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他说，Airbnb的数据显示，SEO长期来看是有效的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew的故事，是典型的生活方式生意（Lifestyle Business）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不追独角兽，不追IPO，就是舒服地活着，做自己喜欢的事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "已經4年了，月收入稳定，他还想做至少10年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的建议很简单："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Just ask。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想知道什么，就去问。独立开发者社区很开放，愿意帮助他人。你只是需要好奇，去问。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还说，参加线下聚会很重要。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他在巴厘岛Canggu参加Hackagu聚会，每周知道其他人在经历什么。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他曾经自己组织过一次聚会，只来了一个人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那个人成了他第一个SaaS的联合创始人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个RSVP，改变一生。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "

content_en: Using Lifetime Deal to do lifestyle business monthly income thirty six thousand. He said I do this not for money but for sense of control. Have you heard enough get rich quick stories. Here is different one. Andrew Kamphey made Google Sheets tutorial site Better Sheets. Monthly income five thousand dollars about thirty six thousand RMB. Living comfortable not anxious. Not for getting rich but for control and independence. One. What did Andrew do before. Automated his own work using Google Apps Script. For five years he did not realize he was learning programming. At that time he worked at entertainment startup colleagues called him that Google Sheets guy. Office corner spreadsheet wizard. He loved helping others solve problems but also dreamed of independent development. Twenty eighteen he quit. Two. First startup sold website and newsletter for thirty seven thousand dollars. At that time annual income was only twelve thousand dollars. Then he became obsessed with SaaS. Spent two years making product called Hypeletter. What happened. Monthly revenue two hundred dollars stuck died. This failure made his real value seen. Partner was looking for domain he made scoring sheet automatically calculating each domain score length com domain available.
